governance_note: ODD classification is applied per-recording per-camera. ODD_SHIFT data cannot enter the primary in-ODD population. This prevents misattribution of ODD failures as generalization failures.

odd_status_taxonomy.IN_ODD: All measured ODD dimensions are within the established operational envelope.
odd_status_taxonomy.ODD_MARGIN: One or more ODD dimensions are near but within the established limits. Flagged for sensitivity analysis.
odd_status_taxonomy.ODD_SHIFT: One or more ODD dimensions fall outside the established operational envelope. Must be analyzed separately as EXP_333_01B.
odd_status_taxonomy.UNKNOWN: Actual measurements are unavailable. ODD status cannot be determined without physical evidence.

EXP_333_01A.label: EXTERNAL_IN_ODD_ZERO_ADAPTATION
EXP_333_01A.description: Tests transfer to a physically independent facility while remaining within the established operational envelope. Primary generalization test.
EXP_333_01A.population_rule: Only recordings where all ODD dimensions are IN_ODD or ODD_MARGIN.

EXP_333_01B.label: EXTERNAL_ODD_SHIFT_ZERO_ADAPTATION
EXP_333_01B.description: Tests external distribution shift where one or more ODD dimensions fall outside the established envelope. Analyzed separately from EXP_333_01A.
EXP_333_01B.population_rule: Only recordings where at least one ODD dimension is ODD_SHIFT.

mixing_prohibition.rule: EXP_333_01A and EXP_333_01B populations must never be mixed in the primary F1 number.
mixing_prohibition.rationale: Mixing prevents correct decomposition of generalization failure vs ODD failure.
mixing_prohibition.enforcement: odd_classification_manifest.json must be completed before any evaluation is executed.

hypothesis_governance.note: The 85% criterion is a PREREGISTERED_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION, not a formal statistical null/alternative hypothesis test unless a complete formal hypothesis testing framework is explicitly implemented.
hypothesis_governance.preregistered_acceptance_criterion: External_Facility_Perception_F1 >= 85.00% on the EXP_333_01A in-ODD population
prohibited_notation: H1: F1 >= 0.85 (unless formally justified with power analysis and test specification)
